def: {remote, literally or figuratively, of place or time; specifically, precious; often used adverbially (with preposition)}

occurrences.text: Now therefore, Tatnai, governor beyond the river, Shethar–boznai, and your companions the Apharsachites, which are beyond the river, be ye far from thence:
